scope: FX3U family instruction inventory; not a qualified target profile
status_baseline: Before the instruction-family qualification campaign; reflects the earlier first-toolchain trial. Later test evidence is separate until reconciled.
coverage_limits: All nonempty FX3U-positive base rows from the captured official application table plus basic/step instructions in manual sections 3.1/3.2.
Not an expansion of every D (32-bit), P (pulse), operand, device-range or firmware variant; base FNC is not the bytecode opcode.
An availability circle is not proof that a particular CPU, attached module, compiler or physical bench can execute the function.
Encoder and hardware fields are frozen to the earlier first-toolchain baseline and must be reconciled with new qualification reports.
No attached hardware was inspected or controlled while constructing this inventory.

evidence_levels.manual_documented: Semantics/applicability documented by Mitsubishi; read exact instruction and firmware conditions before use.
evidence_levels.encoder_baseline: Only the explicitly listed forms are supported by the experimental machine encoder at the baseline.
evidence_levels.hardware_evidence_baseline: Presence in captured running code is weaker than an isolated functional test; new-rung execution proved LDI/MOV together.
evidence_levels.requirements_reviewed: False means that per-instruction hardware/version/operand requirements still require focused review.

sources.extraction: HTML tr cells: 0=FNC, 1=mnemonic, 5=FX3U; skip dash names and cells without circle. Category from preceding h2. Function prose not copied.
